name: securacv_thermal_watchdog
description: SecuraCV Thermal Watchdog — always-on passive die-temperature observer. Samples the shared thermal provider, mirrors the camera's throttle/pause hysteresis as a shadow classifier, accumulates NVS-persisted lifetime thermal history (min/max, throttled/paused minutes, event counts), and surfaces advisories (sensor fault, critical heat, saturation, environment-limited, cold) through the health log. Never actuates — the camera state machine remains the sole thermal actuator.
